name: ai-token-tracker
description: Track token usage and remaining quota for Antigravity CLI and Claude in your VS Code status bar

commands.title: AI Token Tracker: Refresh Usage Data
AI Token Tracker: Set Claude Admin API Key

aiTokenTracker.antigravity.dataDir.description: Path to the Antigravity CLI data directory (defaults to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli)

aiTokenTracker.antigravity.monthlyTokenB.description: Your monthly token budget/limit for Antigravity (Gemini Pro subscription)

aiTokenTracker.claude.adminApiKey.description: Claude Admin API Key (sk-ant-admin-...) for fetching usage data. Leave empty to track locally only.
aiTokenTracker.claude.adminApiKey.markdownDescription: Claude Admin API Key (`sk-ant-admin-...`) for fetching usage from the Anthropic Usage API. Leave empty to track usage locally from response headers.

aiTokenTracker.claude.monthlyBudget.description: Monthly budget in USD for Claude API usage

aiTokenTracker.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often to refresh usage data (in minutes)

aiTokenTracker.statusBar.showAntigravity.description: Show Antigravity usage in status bar

aiTokenTracker.statusBar.showClaude.description: Show Claude usage in status bar
